name: Playwright MCP Server (ExecuteAutomation)
upstream_status_note: No release and no repository activity in the 180 days before 2026-11-14.
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C4, C6, C10; partly meets C1, C7, C8; does not meet C2, C3, C5, C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for @executeautomation/playwright-mcp-server@1.0.12 names the repository `git+https://github.com/executeautomation/mcp-playwright.git`. The record carries no provenance attestation (`dist.attestations` is absent).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub's security-policy page for the repository says "No security policy detected" and offers no private vulnerability reporting; the README names no channel for security reports (searched for: security@, vulnerability, responsible disclosure, report security).

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived, but there has been neither a release nor repository activity in the 180 days before 2026-11-14. Latest release 1.0.12 is dated 2025-12-12; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2025-12-13; GitHub reports the last push on 2025-12-13.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The README describes browser automation including JavaScript execution; no option to restrict navigation, script execution or tools was found in the README. Searched `README.md` for: read-only, allowlist, allowed-(origins, hosts, domains), restrict, disable (tool, script). Quoted: “This server enables LLMs to interact with web pages, take screenshots, generate test code, web scrapes the page and execute JavaScript in a real browser environment.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The documented server setup takes no credential. Quoted: “claude mcp add --transport stdio playwright npx @executeautomation/playwright-mcp-server”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The documented function is driving a browser to arbitrary web pages. The README contains no reference to telemetry. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog. Quoted: “This server enables LLMs to interact with web pages”.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`package-lock.json`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.24.3. Lower-bound version 1.24.3 of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (npm) was published on 2025-12-04, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
